Acerola
Family Malpighiaceae
Scientific name Malpighia punicifolia L.,
Malpighia glabra L.
Common name Barbados cherry, West
Indian cherry, cereza
♥High in vitamin C
♥A good source of vitamin A 
(beta-carotene)
Acerolas are round or oval, cherry-like fruits that range from 2 to 4 inches in
diameter.  When ripe, the skin turns bright red.  The soft, juicy flesh is yellow
and has a slightly tart flavor.
